name: Villanueva de la Reina (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided sapphire blue over golden yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva de la Reina (quartered red and white with a castle).
history: Villanueva de la Reina adopted its arms and flag officially on 26 August 2000; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, divided into two equal stripes perpendicular to the hoist, the upper sapphire blue, referring to the House of Bourbon, and the lower golden yellow, for the fleurs-de-lis of Bourbon-Anjou, with the municipal arms centred and superimposed.

features.role: Villanueva de la Reina arms — quartered red and white with a castle
